summary.intent: Fix a failing E2E test (`bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts`) that verifies bin folder restoration after page reload in the cipher-box app, as part of a larger multi-wave feature implementation.
summary.outcome: Three targeted fixes were applied (loadFolder sequence guard, bin auto-repair re-resolve, nav-guard redirect bounce) but the test remained red at step 6 (`waitForBinItem`, line 116) across all three CI dispatches. Work was parked per the 'red = stop' rule with a detailed handoff document committed.

repo: The bin-restore-after-reload failure was a layered routing issue in `useFolderNavigation`, not an SDK clobber — a stale subfolder resolve was firing `navigate('/files')` after the user reached `/bin`.

The nav-guard fix (latestPathname ref in catch-block redirect) was the correct diagnosis but did not fully resolve the issue, suggesting there is an additional source of the `/bin → /files` bounce not yet identified.
CI gate rule: 'red = stop, no PR on a red gate' — enforced strictly after 3 attempts.
All commits from `fe646fd5f` onward are unsigned due to a 1Password wedge and will require re-signing or admin-merge.

code.finding: Catch-block redirect was using stale pathname; fix added a `latestPathname` ref to guard the redirect so a stale subfolder resolve can't bounce a user who has already navigated to `/bin`.

Test fails at step 6 (`waitForBinItem`) — page is stuck on `/files` root showing a subfolder instead of navigating to `/bin`. The page state after reload lands on `/files`, not `/bin`, despite all three fixes.

workflow: Playwright failure snapshots were the primary diagnostic tool — page URL in snapshot revealed the routing issue (page on `/files` not `/bin`).
Enforcing a fixed attempt ceiling (3 dispatches) prevents runaway unattended CI churn on uncertain fixes.
Writing a structured handoff doc before parking preserves diagnosis context for future sessions.
Typecheck + lint + unit tests (31/31) passing does not guarantee E2E pass — routing behavior requires full integration testing.

friction: 1Password wedged mid-session, forcing all commits from `fe646fd5f` onward to be unsigned — requires manual re-signing or admin-merge before PR can land.
The root cause of the `/bin → /files` bounce was not fully pinned after 3 fix attempts; the nav-guard was the correct layer but insufficient on its own.
CI round-trip time (~12 min per dispatch) made iterative debugging expensive under the 'red = stop' constraint.
The failure was a layered bug (routing + SDK interaction) that the original plan under-scoped, requiring multiple fix iterations beyond the initial estimate.
open_items: `bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts` step 6 still failing — need to identify the remaining source of the `/bin → /files` bounce beyond the `useFolderNavigation` catch-block (could be another redirect, a component-level navigation, or a race condition).
